script:
-- // Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- // Remove existing GUI if already running
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SoccerHQ_StealScript") then
    CoreGui.SoccerHQ_StealScript:Destroy()
end

-- // Main ScreenGui Setup
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SoccerHQ_StealScript"
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- // 1. Toggle Logo Button (Screen par hamesha dikhega)
local toggleLogo = Instance.new("ImageButton")
toggleLogo.Name = "ToggleLogo"
toggleLogo.Parent = screenGui
toggleLogo.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
toggleLogo.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleLogo.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.15, 0)
toggleLogo.Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 55)
toggleLogo.Image = "rbxassetid://6034293437"
toggleLogo.Draggable = true
toggleLogo.Active = true

local logoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
logoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
logoCorner.Parent = toggleLogo

-- // 2. Main GUI Panel
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.2, 0)
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 320)
mainFrame.Visible = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Active = true

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

-- // Title Label (ᴩᴀᴛᴛɪ_ᴅᴇᴠ123 ꜱᴄʀɪᴩᴛ)
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
titleLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
titleLabel.Text = "ᴩᴀᴛᴛɪ_ᴅᴇᴠ123 ꜱᴄʀɪᴩᴛ"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 15

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
titleCorner.Parent = titleLabel

-- // Speed Input Box
local speedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
speedBox.Parent = mainFrame
speedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 65)
speedBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
speedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.17, 0)
speedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 32)
speedBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
speedBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter Speed (e.g. 35, 50)"
speedBox.Text = ""
speedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedBox.TextSize = 14

local boxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
boxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
boxCorner.Parent = speedBox

-- // Start Speed Button
local startButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
startButton.Parent = mainFrame
startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 127)
startButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
startButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.32, 0)
startButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 35)
startButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
startButton.Text = "START SPEED"
startButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
startButton.TextSize = 14

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
btnCorner.Parent = startButton

-- // 1st Button: Set Safe Zone Point
local setPointButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
setPointButton.Parent = mainFrame
setPointButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 0)
setPointButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
setPointButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.47, 0)
setPointButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 35)
setPointButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
setPointButton.Text = "1. SET SAFE ZONE POINT"
setPointButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
setPointButton.TextSize = 13

local setBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
setBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
setBtnCorner.Parent = setPointButton

-- // 2nd Button: Teleport to Saved Safe Zone
local tpButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
tpButton.Parent = mainFrame
tpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
tpButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
tpButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.62, 0)
tpButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 35)
tpButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
tpButton.Text = "2. TP TO SAFE ZONE"
tpButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
tpButton.TextSize = 13

local tpBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
tpBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
tpBtnCorner.Parent = tpButton

-- // Status Text
local statusText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusText.Parent = mainFrame
statusText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusText.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.81, 0)
statusText.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 45)
statusText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
statusText.Text = "Status: Set Safe Zone first!"
statusText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
statusText.TextSize = 12

-- // Logic Variables
local speedEnabled = false
local customSpeed = 16
local savedSafeZoneCFrame = nil

-- // Toggle Logo Function (Logo dabane par GUI hide/unhide hoga)
local guiVisible = true
toggleLogo.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    guiVisible = not guiVisible
    mainFrame.Visible = guiVisible
end)

-- // Start Speed Button Functionality
startButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local userSpeed = tonumber(speedBox.Text)
    if userSpeed then
        customSpeed = userSpeed
        speedEnabled = not speedEnabled
        
        if speedEnabled then
            startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
            startButton.Text = "STOP SPEED"
            statusText.Text = "Speed Active: " .. customSpeed
        else
            startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 127)
            startButton.Text = "START SPEED"
            statusText.Text = "Speed Off"
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
            end
        end
    else
        statusText.Text = "Error: Enter valid speed number!"
    end
end)

-- // STEP 1: Set Safe Zone Point Logic
setPointButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        local char = player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            savedSafeZoneCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            statusText.Text = "Safe Zone Point Saved Successfully!"
        end
    end)
end)

-- // STEP 2: TP to Safe Zone Logic
tpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        if savedSafeZoneCFrame then
            local char = player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = savedSafeZoneCFrame
                statusText.Text = "Teleported back with your Egg/Box!"
            end
        else
            statusText.Text = "Error: Set Safe Zone Point first!"
        end
    end)
end)

-- // Anti-Reset Speed Loop
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if speedEnabled then
        pcall(function()
            local char = player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = customSpeed
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- // Character respawn fix handle
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    character = newChar
    humanoid = newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    rootPart = newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    speedEnabled = false
    startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 127)
    startButton.Text = "START SPEED"
    statusText.Text = "Status: Respawned. Set Point again."
end)
